page.layout: One title page, all lines centred. From top to bottom: the title in spaced capitals and roman type, the subtitle in roman, a bracketed outline of four topics ("De"), the statement of publication, the author's name, a quotation from Gregory, the printer and place, and the date. Show-through from the neighbouring page at the left edge and handwriting above and beside the text are not transcribed.
page.l: petuam doctrinam è sacris Scripturis excerptam,
& in Ecclesia Catholica conseruatam usque ad

l.i: Gratias agimus omnipotenti Deo, qui immutatis pastoribus gregis sui, fidem, quam semel sanctis Patribus tradidit, etiam post eos immutabilem custodit.

page.notes: Handwritten notes, not transcribed: a line above "Gregorius I." reading "Episcopo Chichestrensi", and a handwritten name or mark beside "PROSTAT". At the left edge a handwritten fragment ("Dlej") from the neighbouring page. Partly obscured by stains: "controuersiis" in the 9th line, read as "controuersiis" with a doubtful final letters. The rule under the date and the brace are printed. No engraving is printed.
